--!strict
-- The pure rules of Breakout: scoring, lives, winning, losing and the bounce
-- directions. No engine calls, so the empty-scene suites can test it directly.

export type Phase = "Serve" | "Playing" | "Won" | "GameOver"

export type State = {
	Score: number,
	Lives: number,
	BricksLeft: number,
	Phase: Phase,
}

export type BrickResult = "Ignored" | "Broken" | "Won"
export type BallResult = "Ignored" | "LifeLost" | "GameOver"

local Rules = {}

-- The smallest share of the ball's direction that must point up or down, so
-- the ball never ends up bouncing between the side walls forever.
Rules.MinVertical = 0.3

function Rules.New(brickCount: number, lives: number): State
	return {
		Score = 0,
		Lives = lives,
		BricksLeft = brickCount,
		Phase = "Serve",
	}
end

-- Starts play from the serve. Returns whether the ball was launched.
function Rules.Launch(state: State): boolean
	if state.Phase ~= "Serve" then
		return false
	end
	state.Phase = "Playing"
	return true
end

-- Scores a broken brick; the last brick wins the game.
function Rules.BreakBrick(state: State, points: number): BrickResult
	if state.Phase ~= "Playing" or state.BricksLeft <= 0 then
		return "Ignored"
	end
	state.Score += points
	state.BricksLeft -= 1
	if state.BricksLeft == 0 then
		state.Phase = "Won"
		return "Won"
	end
	return "Broken"
end

-- The ball fell below the paddle: one life is lost; the last one ends the game.
function Rules.LoseBall(state: State): BallResult
	if state.Phase ~= "Playing" then
		return "Ignored"
	end
	state.Lives -= 1
	if state.Lives <= 0 then
		state.Lives = 0
		state.Phase = "GameOver"
		return "GameOver"
	end
	state.Phase = "Serve"
	return "LifeLost"
end

-- Starts a new game in place.
function Rules.Restart(state: State, brickCount: number, lives: number)
	state.Score = 0
	state.Lives = lives
	state.BricksLeft = brickCount
	state.Phase = "Serve"
end

-- The text shown in the middle of the screen in each phase.
function Rules.Message(phase: Phase): string
	if phase == "Serve" then
		return "PRESS SPACE TO LAUNCH"
	elseif phase == "Won" then
		return "YOU WIN!\nPRESS R TO PLAY AGAIN"
	elseif phase == "GameOver" then
		return "GAME OVER\nPRESS R TO RESTART"
	end
	return ""
end

-- The unit direction (x, y) of a ball leaving the paddle: offset is where it
-- hit, from -1 (left edge) to 1 (right edge); the edges give maxAngle degrees
-- from straight up.
function Rules.BounceDirection(offset: number, maxAngle: number): (number, number)
	local angle = math.clamp(offset, -1, 1) * maxAngle * math.pi / 180
	return math.sin(angle), math.cos(angle)
end

-- Normalizes a velocity (vx, vy) to a unit direction whose vertical share is
-- at least minVertical; a ball at rest goes straight up.
function Rules.FixDirection(vx: number, vy: number, minVertical: number): (number, number)
	local length = math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy)
	if length < 1e-6 then
		return 0, 1
	end
	local x, y = vx / length, vy / length
	if math.abs(y) < minVertical then
		y = if y < 0 then -minVertical else minVertical
		local side = math.sqrt(1 - y * y)
		x = if x < 0 then -side else side
	end
	return x, y
end

return Rules

--!strict
-- Runs a game of Breakout: moves the paddle, serves and launches the ball,
-- keeps its speed constant, breaks bricks, counts score and lives, plays the
-- sounds and shows the HUD. The rules themselves live in the Rules module.
local Rules = require("./Rules")
local BrickScript = require("./Brick")

export type Game = ScriptInstance & {
	Ball: Entity?,
	Paddle: Entity?,
	BrickRoot: Entity?,
	ScoreText: Entity?,
	LivesText: Entity?,
	MessageText: Entity?,
	BallSpeed: number,
	PaddleSpeed: number,
	PaddleLimit: number,
	PaddleHalfWidth: number,
	BallRadius: number,
	DeathY: number,
	StartLives: number,
	MaxBounceAngle: number,
	PaddleHitSound: AssetRef?,
	WallHitSound: AssetRef?,
	BrickBreakSound: AssetRef?,
	LifeLostSound: AssetRef?,
	WinSound: AssetRef?,
	GameOverSound: AssetRef?,

	State: Rules.State,
	Bricks: { Entity },
	PaddleX: number,
	PaddleY: number,
	PaddleHits: number,
	WallHits: number,
	BricksBroken: number,
	LivesLost: number,

	OnBallHit: (self: Game, other: Entity, contact: CollisionContact) -> (),
	BreakBrick: (self: Game, brick: Entity) -> (),
	LoseBall: (self: Game) -> (),
	Launch: (self: Game, offset: number) -> (),
	Restart: (self: Game) -> (),
	ResetBall: (self: Game) -> (),
	SetBallVelocity: (self: Game, x: number, y: number) -> (),
	UpdateHud: (self: Game) -> (),
	Play: (self: Game, clip: AssetRef?) -> (),
}

local Game = {}

Game.Fields = {
	Ball = Field.Entity(),
	Paddle = Field.Entity(),
	BrickRoot = Field.Entity(),
	ScoreText = Field.Entity(),
	LivesText = Field.Entity(),
	MessageText = Field.Entity(),
	BallSpeed = Field.Number(9, { Min = 1, Tooltip = "The ball's constant speed, in metres per second." }),
	PaddleSpeed = Field.Number(14, { Min = 1, Tooltip = "The paddle's speed, in metres per second." }),
	PaddleLimit = Field.Number(7.3, { Min = 0, Tooltip = "How far the paddle centre may move from x = 0." }),
	PaddleHalfWidth = Field.Number(1.2, { Min = 0.1, Tooltip = "Half the paddle's width, in metres." }),
	BallRadius = Field.Number(0.25, { Min = 0.05, Tooltip = "The ball's radius, in metres." }),
	DeathY = Field.Number(-8.5, { Tooltip = "The ball is lost once its centre falls below this height." }),
	StartLives = Field.Integer(3, { Min = 1, Tooltip = "The lives of a new game." }),
	MaxBounceAngle = Field.Number(60, { Min = 0, Max = 75, Tooltip = "The bounce angle from vertical at the paddle's edges, in degrees." }),
	PaddleHitSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	WallHitSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	BrickBreakSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	LifeLostSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	WinSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	GameOverSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
}

-- The ball's centre sits this far above the paddle's centre while serving.
local ServeHeight = 0.5

-- The launch leaves the paddle this far towards its right (or left) edge.
local LaunchOffset = 0.35

local function setText(entity: Entity?, value: string)
	if entity then
		local text = entity.Text
		if text and text.Text ~= value then
			text.Text = value
		end
	end
end

function Game.Play(self: Game, clip: AssetRef?)
	if clip then
		Audio.PlayOneShot(clip)
	end
end

function Game.UpdateHud(self: Game)
	setText(self.ScoreText, "SCORE " .. tostring(self.State.Score))
	setText(self.LivesText, "LIVES " .. tostring(self.State.Lives))
	setText(self.MessageText, Rules.Message(self.State.Phase))
end

function Game.SetBallVelocity(self: Game, x: number, y: number)
	local ball = self.Ball
	if ball then
		local body = ball.RigidBody
		if body then
			body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.create(x * self.BallSpeed, y * self.BallSpeed, 0))
		end
	end
end

-- Parks the ball on the paddle, at rest.
function Game.ResetBall(self: Game)
	local ball = self.Ball
	if ball then
		local body = ball.RigidBody
		if body then
			body:Teleport(vector.create(self.PaddleX, self.PaddleY + ServeHeight, 0))
			body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.create(0, 0, 0))
		end
	end
end

function Game.Launch(self: Game, offset: number)
	if not Rules.Launch(self.State) then
		return
	end
	local x, y = Rules.BounceDirection(offset, self.MaxBounceAngle)
	self:SetBallVelocity(x, y)
	self:UpdateHud()
end

function Game.BreakBrick(self: Game, brick: Entity)
	if not brick:IsValid() or not brick:IsActiveSelf() then
		return
	end
	local script = brick:GetScript() :: BrickScript.Brick?
	local points = if script then script.Points else 1
	local result = Rules.BreakBrick(self.State, points)
	if result == "Ignored" then
		return
	end
	brick:SetActive(false)
	self.BricksBroken += 1
	if result == "Won" then
		self:ResetBall()
		self:Play(self.WinSound)
	else
		self:Play(self.BrickBreakSound)
	end
	self:UpdateHud()
end

function Game.LoseBall(self: Game)
	local result = Rules.LoseBall(self.State)
	if result == "Ignored" then
		return
	end
	self.LivesLost += 1
	self:ResetBall()
	if result == "GameOver" then
		self:Play(self.GameOverSound)
	else
		self:Play(self.LifeLostSound)
	end
	self:UpdateHud()
end

function Game.Restart(self: Game)
	for _, brick in ipairs(self.Bricks) do
		if brick:IsValid() and not brick:IsActiveSelf() then
			brick:SetActive(true)
		end
	end
	Rules.Restart(self.State, #self.Bricks, self.StartLives)
	self.PaddleX = 0
	local paddle = self.Paddle
	if paddle then
		local body = paddle.RigidBody
		if body then
			body:Teleport(vector.create(self.PaddleX, self.PaddleY, 0))
		end
	end
	self:ResetBall()
	self:UpdateHud()
end

-- Called by the Ball behaviour when the ball starts touching something.
function Game.OnBallHit(self: Game, other: Entity, contact: CollisionContact)
	if self.State.Phase ~= "Playing" then
		return
	end
	if other:HasTag("Paddle") then
		local ball = self.Ball
		if not ball then
			return
		end
		local ballPosition = ball.Transform.WorldPosition
		local paddlePosition = other.Transform.WorldPosition
		-- Only the top of the paddle steers; a ball already below it is lost.
		if ballPosition.y > paddlePosition.y then
			local offset = (ballPosition.x - paddlePosition.x) / (self.PaddleHalfWidth + self.BallRadius)
			local x, y = Rules.BounceDirection(offset, self.MaxBounceAngle)
			self:SetBallVelocity(x, y)
		end
		self.PaddleHits += 1
		self:Play(self.PaddleHitSound)
	elseif other:HasTag("Brick") then
		self:BreakBrick(other)
	elseif other:HasTag("Wall") then
		self.WallHits += 1
		self:Play(self.WallHitSound)
	end
end

function Game.OnStart(self: Game)
	self.Bricks = {}
	local root = self.BrickRoot
	if root then
		for _, child in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
			if child:HasTag("Brick") then
				table.insert(self.Bricks, child)
			end
		end
	end
	local paddle = self.Paddle
	local paddlePosition = if paddle then paddle.Transform.WorldPosition else vector.create(0, -6.5, 0)
	self.PaddleX = paddlePosition.x
	self.PaddleY = paddlePosition.y
	self.PaddleHits = 0
	self.WallHits = 0
	self.BricksBroken = 0
	self.LivesLost = 0
	self.State = Rules.New(#self.Bricks, self.StartLives)
	self:ResetBall()
	self:UpdateHud()
end

function Game.OnFixedUpdate(self: Game, dt: number)
	if Input.IsActionPressed("Restart") then
		self:Restart()
		return
	end

	local axis = Input.GetAxis("MoveX")
	self.PaddleX = math.clamp(self.PaddleX + axis * self.PaddleSpeed * dt, -self.PaddleLimit, self.PaddleLimit)
	local paddle = self.Paddle
	if paddle then
		local body = paddle.RigidBody
		if body then
			body:MoveKinematic(vector.create(self.PaddleX, self.PaddleY, 0), Quat.Identity())
		end
	end

	local phase = self.State.Phase
	if phase == "Playing" then
		local ball = self.Ball
		if ball then
			if ball.Transform.WorldPosition.y < self.DeathY then
				self:LoseBall()
			else
				local body = ball.RigidBody
				if body then
					local velocity = body:GetLinearVelocity()
					local x, y = Rules.FixDirection(velocity.x, velocity.y, Rules.MinVertical)
					self:SetBallVelocity(x, y)
				end
			end
		end
	else
		-- Serving, won or over: the ball rests on the paddle and follows it.
		self:ResetBall()
		if phase == "Serve" and Input.IsActionPressed("Launch") then
			self:Launch(if axis < 0 then -LaunchOffset else LaunchOffset)
		end
	end
end

return Script.Define("Game", Game)

--!strict
-- The rules of Breakout played in the Main scene: serving, launching, the
-- paddle, scoring, losing lives, game over, winning and restarting.
local GameScript = require("../Scripts/Game")
local BrickScript = require("../Scripts/Brick")

local function getGame(): GameScript.Game
	local entity = Scene.FindByName("Game")
	if entity == nil then
		Test.Fail("the scene has no Game entity")
	end
	return (entity :: Entity):GetScript() :: GameScript.Game
end

local function textOf(entity: Entity?): string
	if entity then
		local text = entity.Text
		if text then
			return text.Text
		end
	end
	return ""
end

local function launch(game: GameScript.Game)
	Test.InjectAction("Launch", "Tap")
	Test.WaitUntil(function(): boolean
		return game.State.Phase == "Playing"
	end, 10)
end

-- Test setup: puts the ball below the paddle and waits until the game has
-- noticed that it fell out.
local function dropBall(game: GameScript.Game)
	local ball = game.Ball :: Entity
	local body = ball.RigidBody :: RigidBody
	body:Teleport(vector.create(0, game.DeathY - 1, 0))
	Test.WaitUntil(function(): boolean
		return game.State.Phase ~= "Playing"
	end, 10)
end

local function activeBricks(game: GameScript.Game): number
	local count = 0
	for _, brick in ipairs(game.Bricks) do
		if brick:IsActive() then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

local function ballSpeed(game: GameScript.Game): number
	local ball = game.Ball :: Entity
	local body = ball.RigidBody :: RigidBody
	return vector.magnitude(body:GetLinearVelocity())
end

return Test.Suite("Breakout", function()
	Test.Case("starts serving with full lives and every brick", function()
		local game = getGame()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Phase, "Serve")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Lives, 3)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Score, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(#game.Bricks, 50, "the grid has 5 rows of 10 bricks")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.BricksLeft, 50)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.ScoreText), "SCORE 0")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.LivesText), "LIVES 3")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.MessageText), "PRESS SPACE TO LAUNCH")
	end)

	Test.Case("launch sends the ball up at a constant speed", function()
		local game = getGame()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectNear(ballSpeed(game), 0, 1e-4, "the served ball rests on the paddle")
		launch(game)
		Test.WaitTicks(20)
		local ball = game.Ball :: Entity
		local body = ball.RigidBody :: RigidBody
		Test.Expect(body:GetLinearVelocity().y > 0, "the ball flies up")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.MessageText), "")
		for _ = 1, 10 do
			Test.WaitTicks(30)
			Test.ExpectNear(ballSpeed(game), game.BallSpeed, 1e-3, "the ball keeps its speed")
			Test.ExpectNear(ball.Transform.WorldPosition.z, 0, 1e-4, "the ball stays in the play plane")
		end
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 900 })

	Test.Case("the paddle follows MoveX and stops at the walls", function()
		local game = getGame()
		local paddle = game.Paddle :: Entity
		Test.InjectAction("MoveX", nil, 1)
		Test.WaitTicks(90)
		Test.ExpectNear(game.PaddleX, game.PaddleLimit, 1e-4, "the paddle stops at the right wall")
		Test.ExpectNear(paddle.Transform.WorldPosition.x, game.PaddleLimit, 1e-3)
		Test.InjectAction("MoveX", nil, -1)
		Test.WaitTicks(150)
		Test.ExpectNear(game.PaddleX, -game.PaddleLimit, 1e-4, "the paddle stops at the left wall")
		Test.InjectAction("MoveX", nil, 0)
		Test.WaitTicks(5)
		local ball = game.Ball :: Entity
		Test.ExpectNear(ball.Transform.WorldPosition.x, -game.PaddleLimit, 1e-3, "the served ball follows the paddle")
	end)

	Test.Case("the ball breaks the brick it hits and scores", function()
		local game = getGame()
		launch(game)
		Test.WaitUntil(function(): boolean
			return game.BricksBroken > 0
		end, 240)
		Test.Expect(game.State.Score > 0, "breaking a brick scores")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.BricksLeft, 50 - game.BricksBroken)
		Test.ExpectEqual(activeBricks(game), game.State.BricksLeft, "broken bricks disappear")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.ScoreText), "SCORE " .. tostring(game.State.Score))
	end)

	Test.Case("each row scores its own points", function()
		local game = getGame()
		launch(game)
		local expected = { 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 }
		local score = 0
		for row = 1, 5 do
			local brick = Scene.FindByName(string.format("Brick_R%d_C01", row)) :: Entity
			local script = brick:GetScript() :: BrickScript.Brick
			Test.ExpectEqual(script.Points, expected[row])
			game:BreakBrick(brick)
			score += expected[row]
			Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Score, score)
			Test.Expect(not brick:IsActive(), "a broken brick is gone")
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.BricksLeft, 45)
	end)

	Test.Case("losing the ball costs a life and serves again", function()
		local game = getGame()
		launch(game)
		dropBall(game)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Lives, 2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Phase, "Serve")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.LivesText), "LIVES 2")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.MessageText), "PRESS SPACE TO LAUNCH")
		Test.WaitTicks(2)
		local ball = game.Ball :: Entity
		Test.ExpectNear(ball.Transform.WorldPosition.y, game.PaddleY + 0.5, 1e-3, "the ball is back on the paddle")
	end)

	Test.Case("the game is over when the last life is lost", function()
		local game = getGame()
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			launch(game)
			dropBall(game)
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Lives, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Phase, "GameOver")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.MessageText), "GAME OVER\nPRESS R TO RESTART")
		Test.InjectAction("Launch", "Tap")
		Test.WaitTicks(5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Phase, "GameOver", "launch does nothing after the game is over")
	end)

	Test.Case("breaking every brick wins", function()
		local game = getGame()
		launch(game)
		for _, brick in ipairs(game.Bricks) do
			game:BreakBrick(brick)
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Phase, "Won")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.BricksLeft, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Score, 10 * (5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1))
		Test.ExpectEqual(activeBricks(game), 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.MessageText), "YOU WIN!\nPRESS R TO PLAY AGAIN")
		Test.WaitTicks(2)
		Test.ExpectNear(ballSpeed(game), 0, 1e-4, "the ball stops on the paddle after the win")
	end)

	Test.Case("restart after game over starts a new game", function()
		local game = getGame()
		launch(game)
		game:BreakBrick(Scene.FindByName("Brick_R1_C05") :: Entity)
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			if game.State.Phase == "Serve" then
				launch(game)
			end

-- ball once more and finally restarts the game.

-- the ball, so the bounces leave at an angle.

	local entity = Scene.FindByName("Game")
	if entity == nil then

	end
	return (entity :: Entity):GetScript() :: GameScript.Game
end

	return (game.Ball :: Entity).Transform.WorldPosition.x
end

-- Pushes MoveX towards the paddle position x for one tick.
local function steer(game: GameScript.Game, x: number)
	local paddle = game.Paddle :: Entity
	local dx = x - paddle.Transform.WorldPosition.x
	Test.InjectAction("MoveX", nil, math.clamp(dx * Gain, -1, 1))
	Test.WaitTicks(1)
end

	Test.InjectAction("Launch", "Tap")
	Test.WaitTicks(2)
end

-- Follows the ball with the paddle until done() holds, serving again
-- whenever a ball is lost.
local function rally(game: GameScript.Game, done: () -> boolean)
	while not done() do
		if game.State.Phase == "Serve" then
			serve()
		else
			steer(game, ballX(game) - AimOffset)
		end
	end

--!strict
-- The pure rules of Breakout: scoring, lives, winning, losing, the bounce
-- directions and the ball's speed-up. No engine calls, so the empty-scene
-- suites can test it directly.

export type Phase = "Serve" | "Playing" | "Won" | "GameOver"

export type State = {
	Score: number,
	Lives: number,
	BricksLeft: number,
	Phase: Phase,
	-- Paddle hits since the ball was last served; the ball speeds up with them.
	RallyHits: number,
}

export type BrickResult = "Ignored" | "Broken" | "Won"
export type BallResult = "Ignored" | "LifeLost" | "GameOver"

-- How the ball speeds up during a rally: every HitsPerStep paddle hits add
-- Step metres per second to Base, up to Max.
export type SpeedRule = {
	Base: number,
	HitsPerStep: number,
	Step: number,
	Max: number,
}

local Rules = {}

-- The smallest share of the ball's direction that must point up or down, so
-- the ball never ends up bouncing between the side walls forever.
Rules.MinVertical = 0.3

function Rules.New(brickCount: number, lives: number): State
	return {
		Score = 0,
		Lives = lives,
		BricksLeft = brickCount,
		Phase = "Serve",
		RallyHits = 0,
	}
end

-- Starts play from the serve. Returns whether the ball was launched.
function Rules.Launch(state: State): boolean
	if state.Phase ~= "Serve" then
		return false
	end
	state.Phase = "Playing"
	state.RallyHits = 0
	return true
end

-- Counts a paddle hit of the ball in play. Returns whether it counted.
function Rules.PaddleHit(state: State): boolean
	if state.Phase ~= "Playing" then
		return false
	end
	state.RallyHits += 1
	return true
end

-- Scores a broken brick; the last brick wins the game.
function Rules.BreakBrick(state: State, points: number): BrickResult
	if state.Phase ~= "Playing" or state.BricksLeft <= 0 then
		return "Ignored"
	end
	state.Score += points
	state.BricksLeft -= 1
	if state.BricksLeft == 0 then
		state.Phase = "Won"
		state.RallyHits = 0
		return "Won"
	end
	return "Broken"
end

-- The ball fell below the paddle: one life is lost; the last one ends the game.
function Rules.LoseBall(state: State): BallResult
	if state.Phase ~= "Playing" then
		return "Ignored"
	end
	state.Lives -= 1
	state.RallyHits = 0
	if state.Lives <= 0 then
		state.Lives = 0
		state.Phase = "GameOver"
		return "GameOver"
	end
	state.Phase = "Serve"
	return "LifeLost"
end

-- Starts a new game in place.
function Rules.Restart(state: State, brickCount: number, lives: number)
	state.Score = 0
	state.Lives = lives
	state.BricksLeft = brickCount
	state.Phase = "Serve"
	state.RallyHits = 0
end

-- The ball's speed after rallyHits paddle hits: one Step per completed
-- HitsPerStep hits, never above Max and never below Base.
function Rules.BallSpeed(rule: SpeedRule, rallyHits: number): number
	local steps = math.floor(math.max(rallyHits, 0) / math.max(rule.HitsPerStep, 1))
	local speed = rule.Base + steps * math.max(rule.Step, 0)
	return math.min(speed, math.max(rule.Max, rule.Base))
end

-- The text shown in the middle of the screen in each phase.
function Rules.Message(phase: Phase): string
	if phase == "Serve" then
		return "PRESS SPACE TO LAUNCH"
	elseif phase == "Won" then
		return "YOU WIN!\nPRESS R TO PLAY AGAIN"
	elseif phase == "GameOver" then
		return "GAME OVER\nPRESS R TO RESTART"
	end
	return ""
end

-- The unit direction (x, y) of a ball leaving the paddle: offset is where it
-- hit, from -1 (left edge) to 1 (right edge); the edges give maxAngle degrees
-- from straight up.
function Rules.BounceDirection(offset: number, maxAngle: number): (number, number)
	local angle = math.clamp(offset, -1, 1) * maxAngle * math.pi / 180
	return math.sin(angle), math.cos(angle)
end

-- Normalizes a velocity (vx, vy) to a unit direction whose vertical share is
-- at least minVertical; a ball at rest goes straight up.
function Rules.FixDirection(vx: number, vy: number, minVertical: number): (number, number)
	local length = math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy)
	if length < 1e-6 then
		return 0, 1
	end
	local x, y = vx / length, vy / length
	if math.abs(y) < minVertical then
		y = if y < 0 then -minVertical else minVertical
		local side = math.sqrt(1 - y * y)
		x = if x < 0 then -side else side
	end
	return x, y
end

return Rules

--!strict
-- Runs a game of Breakout: moves the paddle, serves and launches the ball,
-- keeps its speed constant between speed-ups (every few paddle hits of a
-- rally, up to a cap), breaks bricks, counts score and lives, plays the
-- sounds and shows the HUD. The rules themselves live in the Rules module.
local Rules = require("./Rules")
local BrickScript = require("./Brick")

export type Game = ScriptInstance & {
	Ball: Entity?,
	Paddle: Entity?,
	BrickRoot: Entity?,
	ScoreText: Entity?,
	LivesText: Entity?,
	MessageText: Entity?,
	BallSpeed: number,
	SpeedUpHits: number,
	SpeedStep: number,
	MaxBallSpeed: number,
	PaddleSpeed: number,
	PaddleLimit: number,
	PaddleHalfWidth: number,
	BallRadius: number,
	DeathY: number,
	StartLives: number,
	MaxBounceAngle: number,
	PaddleHitSound: AssetRef?,
	WallHitSound: AssetRef?,
	BrickBreakSound: AssetRef?,
	LifeLostSound: AssetRef?,
	WinSound: AssetRef?,
	GameOverSound: AssetRef?,

	State: Rules.State,
	Bricks: { Entity },
	PaddleX: number,
	PaddleY: number,
	PaddleHits: number,
	WallHits: number,
	BricksBroken: number,
	LivesLost: number,

	OnBallHit: (self: Game, other: Entity, contact: CollisionContact) -> (),
	BreakBrick: (self: Game, brick: Entity) -> (),
	LoseBall: (self: Game) -> (),
	Launch: (self: Game, offset: number) -> (),
	Restart: (self: Game) -> (),
	ResetBall: (self: Game) -> (),
	CurrentSpeed: (self: Game) -> number,
	SetBallVelocity: (self: Game, x: number, y: number) -> (),
	UpdateHud: (self: Game) -> (),
	Play: (self: Game, clip: AssetRef?) -> (),
}

local Game = {}

Game.Fields = {
	Ball = Field.Entity(),
	Paddle = Field.Entity(),
	BrickRoot = Field.Entity(),
	ScoreText = Field.Entity(),
	LivesText = Field.Entity(),
	MessageText = Field.Entity(),
	BallSpeed = Field.Number(9, { Min = 1, Tooltip = "The ball's speed when served, in metres per second." }),
	SpeedUpHits = Field.Integer(4, { Min = 1, Tooltip = "Paddle hits in one rally per speed-up of the ball." }),
	SpeedStep = Field.Number(1, { Min = 0, Tooltip = "How much faster each speed-up makes the ball, in metres per second." }),
	MaxBallSpeed = Field.Number(13, { Min = 1, Tooltip = "The fastest the ball gets, in metres per second." }),
	PaddleSpeed = Field.Number(14, { Min = 1, Tooltip = "The paddle's speed, in metres per second." }),
	PaddleLimit = Field.Number(7.3, { Min = 0, Tooltip = "How far the paddle centre may move from x = 0." }),
	PaddleHalfWidth = Field.Number(1.2, { Min = 0.1, Tooltip = "Half the paddle's width, in metres." }),
	BallRadius = Field.Number(0.25, { Min = 0.05, Tooltip = "The ball's radius, in metres." }),
	DeathY = Field.Number(-8.5, { Tooltip = "The ball is lost once its centre falls below this height." }),
	StartLives = Field.Integer(3, { Min = 1, Tooltip = "The lives of a new game." }),
	MaxBounceAngle = Field.Number(60, { Min = 0, Max = 75, Tooltip = "The bounce angle from vertical at the paddle's edges, in degrees." }),
	PaddleHitSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	WallHitSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	BrickBreakSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	LifeLostSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	WinSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	GameOverSound = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
}

-- The ball's centre sits this far above the paddle's centre while serving.
local ServeHeight = 0.5

-- The launch leaves the paddle this far towards its right (or left) edge.
local LaunchOffset = 0.35

local function setText(entity: Entity?, value: string)
	if entity then
		local text = entity.Text
		if text and text.Text ~= value then
			text.Text = value
		end
	end
end

function Game.Play(self: Game, clip: AssetRef?)
	if clip then
		Audio.PlayOneShot(clip)
	end
end

function Game.UpdateHud(self: Game)
	setText(self.ScoreText, "SCORE " .. tostring(self.State.Score))
	setText(self.LivesText, "LIVES " .. tostring(self.State.Lives))
	setText(self.MessageText, Rules.Message(self.State.Phase))
end

-- The speed the ball keeps now: the serve speed plus the rally's speed-ups.
function Game.CurrentSpeed(self: Game): number
	return Rules.BallSpeed({
		Base = self.BallSpeed,
		HitsPerStep = self.SpeedUpHits,
		Step = self.SpeedStep,
		Max = self.MaxBallSpeed,
	}, self.State.RallyHits)
end

function Game.SetBallVelocity(self: Game, x: number, y: number)
	local ball = self.Ball
	if ball then
		local body = ball.RigidBody
		if body then
			local speed = self:CurrentSpeed()
			body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.create(x * speed, y * speed, 0))
		end
	end
end

-- Parks the ball on the paddle, at rest.
function Game.ResetBall(self: Game)
	local ball = self.Ball
	if ball then
		local body = ball.RigidBody
		if body then
			body:Teleport(vector.create(self.PaddleX, self.PaddleY + ServeHeight, 0))
			body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.create(0, 0, 0))
		end
	end
end

function Game.Launch(self: Game, offset: number)
	if not Rules.Launch(self.State) then
		return
	end
	local x, y = Rules.BounceDirection(offset, self.MaxBounceAngle)
	self:SetBallVelocity(x, y)
	self:UpdateHud()
end

function Game.BreakBrick(self: Game, brick: Entity)
	if not brick:IsValid() or not brick:IsActiveSelf() then
		return
	end
	local script = brick:GetScript() :: BrickScript.Brick?
	local points = if script then script.Points else 1
	local result = Rules.BreakBrick(self.State, points)
	if result == "Ignored" then
		return
	end
	brick:SetActive(false)
	self.BricksBroken += 1
	if result == "Won" then
		self:ResetBall()
		self:Play(self.WinSound)
	else
		self:Play(self.BrickBreakSound)
	end
	self:UpdateHud()
end

function Game.LoseBall(self: Game)
	local result = Rules.LoseBall(self.State)
	if result == "Ignored" then
		return
	end
	self.LivesLost += 1
	self:ResetBall()
	if result == "GameOver" then
		self:Play(self.GameOverSound)
	else
		self:Play(self.LifeLostSound)
	end
	self:UpdateHud()
end

function Game.Restart(self: Game)
	for _, brick in ipairs(self.Bricks) do
		if brick:IsValid() and not brick:IsActiveSelf() then
			brick:SetActive(true)
		end
	end
	Rules.Restart(self.State, #self.Bricks, self.StartLives)
	self.PaddleX = 0
	local paddle = self.Paddle
	if paddle then
		local body = paddle.RigidBody
		if body then
			body:Teleport(vector.create(self.PaddleX, self.PaddleY, 0))
		end
	end
	self:ResetBall()
	self:UpdateHud()
end

-- Called by the Ball behaviour when the ball starts touching something.
function Game.OnBallHit(self: Game, other: Entity, contact: CollisionContact)
	if self.State.Phase ~= "Playing" then
		return
	end
	if other:HasTag("Paddle") then
		local ball = self.Ball
		if not ball then
			return
		end
		-- Count the hit first, so a speed-up applies to this bounce.
		Rules.PaddleHit(self.State)
		local ballPosition = ball.Transform.WorldPosition
		local paddlePosition = other.Transform.WorldPosition
		-- Only the top of the paddle steers; a ball already below it is lost.
		if ballPosition.y > paddlePosition.y then
			local offset = (ballPosition.x - paddlePosition.x) / (self.PaddleHalfWidth + self.BallRadius)
			local x, y = Rules.BounceDirection(offset, self.MaxBounceAngle)
			self:SetBallVelocity(x, y)
		end
		self.PaddleHits += 1
		self:Play(self.PaddleHitSound)
	elseif other:HasTag("Brick") then
		self:BreakBrick(other)
	elseif other:HasTag("Wall") then
		self.WallHits += 1
		self:Play(self.WallHitSound)
	end
end

function Game.OnStart(self: Game)
	self.Bricks = {}
	local root = self.BrickRoot
	if root then
		for _, child in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
			if child:HasTag("Brick") then
				table.insert(self.Bricks, child)
			end
		end
	end
	local paddle = self.Paddle
	local paddlePosition = if paddle then paddle.Transform.WorldPosition else vector.create(0, -6.5, 0)
	self.PaddleX = paddlePosition.x
	self.PaddleY = paddlePosition.y
	self.PaddleHits = 0
	self.WallHits = 0
	self.BricksBroken = 0
	self.LivesLost = 0
	self.State = Rules.New(#self.Bricks, self.StartLives)
	self:ResetBall()
	self:UpdateHud()
end

function Game.OnFixedUpdate(self: Game, dt: number)
	if Input.IsActionPressed("Restart") then
		self:Restart()
		return
	end

	local axis = Input.GetAxis("MoveX")
	self.PaddleX = math.clamp(self.PaddleX + axis * self.PaddleSpeed * dt, -self.PaddleLimit, self.PaddleLimit)
	local paddle = self.Paddle
	if paddle then
		local body = paddle.RigidBody
		if body then
			body:MoveKinematic(vector.create(self.PaddleX, self.PaddleY, 0), Quat.Identity())
		end
	end

	local phase = self.State.Phase
	if phase == "Playing" then
		local ball = self.Ball
		if ball then
			if ball.Transform.WorldPosition.y < self.DeathY then
				self:LoseBall()
			else
				local body = ball.RigidBody
				if body then
					local velocity = body:GetLinearVelocity()
					local x, y = Rules.FixDirection(velocity.x, velocity.y, Rules.MinVertical)
					self:SetBallVelocity(x, y)
				end
			end
		end
	else
		-- Serving, won or over: the ball rests on the paddle and follows it.
		self:ResetBall()
		if phase == "Serve" and Input.IsActionPressed("Launch") then
			self:Launch(if axis < 0 then -LaunchOffset else LaunchOffset)
		end
	end
end

return Script.Define("Game", Game)

--!strict
-- The pure Breakout rules, without a scene.
local Rules = require("../Scripts/Rules")

local function playing(bricks: number, lives: number): Rules.State
	local state = Rules.New(bricks, lives)
	Rules.Launch(state)
	return state
end

-- The game's default speed-up: 9 m/s served, +1 m/s every 4 paddle hits, at most 13 m/s.
local DefaultSpeed: Rules.SpeedRule = { Base = 9, HitsPerStep = 4, Step = 1, Max = 13 }

return Test.Suite("Rules", function()
	Test.Case("a new game serves with its lives and bricks", function()
		local state = Rules.New(50, 3)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Phase, "Serve")
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Score, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Lives, 3)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.BricksLeft, 50)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.RallyHits, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.Message(state.Phase), "PRESS SPACE TO LAUNCH")
	end)

	Test.Case("launch only starts play from the serve", function()
		local state = Rules.New(5, 3)
		Test.Expect(Rules.Launch(state), "the serve launches")
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Phase, "Playing")
		Test.Expect(not Rules.Launch(state), "a ball in play cannot launch again")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.Message(state.Phase), "")
	end)

	Test.Case("breaking a brick adds its points", function()
		local state = playing(3, 3)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BreakBrick(state, 5), "Broken")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BreakBrick(state, 2), "Broken")
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Score, 7)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.BricksLeft, 1)
	end)

	Test.Case("bricks score nothing outside play", function()
		local state = Rules.New(3, 3)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BreakBrick(state, 5), "Ignored")
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Score, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.BricksLeft, 3)
	end)

	Test.Case("the last brick wins", function()
		local state = playing(2, 3)
		Rules.BreakBrick(state, 1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BreakBrick(state, 4), "Won")
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Phase, "Won")
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Score, 5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BreakBrick(state, 4), "Ignored", "nothing scores after the win")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.Message(state.Phase), "YOU WIN!\nPRESS R TO PLAY AGAIN")
	end)

	Test.Case("losing the ball costs a life and serves again", function()
		local state = playing(10, 3)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.LoseBall(state), "LifeLost")
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Lives, 2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Phase, "Serve")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.LoseBall(state), "Ignored", "a served ball cannot be lost")
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Lives, 2)
	end)

	Test.Case("the last life ends the game", function()
		local state = playing(10, 2)
		Rules.LoseBall(state)
		Rules.Launch(state)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.LoseBall(state), "GameOver")
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Lives, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Phase, "GameOver")
		Test.Expect(not Rules.Launch(state), "a finished game cannot launch")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.Message(state.Phase), "GAME OVER\nPRESS R TO RESTART")
	end)

	Test.Case("restart starts a new game", function()
		local state = playing(10, 1)
		Rules.BreakBrick(state, 3)
		Rules.PaddleHit(state)
		Rules.LoseBall(state)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Phase, "GameOver")
		Rules.Restart(state, 10, 3)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Phase, "Serve")
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Score, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.Lives, 3)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.BricksLeft, 10)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.RallyHits, 0)
	end)

	Test.Case("the paddle steers the bounce by where it is hit", function()
		local x, y = Rules.BounceDirection(0, 60)
		Test.ExpectNear(x, 0, 1e-6)
		Test.ExpectNear(y, 1, 1e-6)
		x, y = Rules.BounceDirection(1, 60)
		Test.ExpectNear(x, math.sin(math.pi / 3), 1e-6)
		Test.ExpectNear(y, 0.5, 1e-6)
		local left, _ = Rules.BounceDirection(-2, 60)
		Test.ExpectNear(left, -math.sin(math.pi / 3), 1e-6, "offsets beyond the edge are clamped")
	end)

	Test.Case("directions stay unit length and never too flat", function()
		local x, y = Rules.FixDirection(3, 4, Rules.MinVertical)
		Test.ExpectNear(x, 0.6, 1e-6)
		Test.ExpectNear(y, 0.8, 1e-6)
		x, y = Rules.FixDirection(-10, 0.1, Rules.MinVertical)
		Test.ExpectNear(y, Rules.MinVertical, 1e-6, "a flat ball is tilted up")
		Test.Expect(x < 0, "the horizontal direction is kept")
		Test.ExpectNear(x * x + y * y, 1, 1e-6)
		x, y = Rules.FixDirection(0, 0, Rules.MinVertical)
		Test.ExpectEqual(x, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(y, 1)
	end)

	Test.Case("paddle hits count only in play and reset with every serve", function()
		local state = Rules.New(10, 3)
		Test.Expect(not Rules.PaddleHit(state), "a served ball does not count")
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.RallyHits, 0)
		Rules.Launch(state)
		for _ = 1, 5 do
			Test.Expect(Rules.PaddleHit(state), "a ball in play counts")
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.RallyHits, 5)
		Rules.LoseBall(state)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.RallyHits, 0, "a lost ball ends the rally")
		Rules.Launch(state)
		Rules.PaddleHit(state)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.RallyHits, 1, "the next serve starts a new rally")
		Rules.Launch(state)
		Test.ExpectEqual(state.RallyHits, 1, "a refused launch keeps the rally")
	end)

	Test.Case("the ball speeds up every few paddle hits up to a cap", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BallSpeed(DefaultSpeed, 0), 9, "a served ball has the base speed")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BallSpeed(DefaultSpeed, 3), 9, "no speed-up before the fourth hit")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BallSpeed(DefaultSpeed, 4), 10, "the fourth hit speeds it up")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BallSpeed(DefaultSpeed, 7), 10)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BallSpeed(DefaultSpeed, 8), 11, "the eighth hit speeds it up again")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BallSpeed(DefaultSpeed, 16), 13, "the sixteenth hit reaches the cap")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BallSpeed(DefaultSpeed, 1000), 13, "the cap holds")
		local lowCap: Rules.SpeedRule = { Base = 9, HitsPerStep = 1, Step = 2, Max = 6 }
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BallSpeed(lowCap, 5), 9, "a cap below the base never slows the ball")
		local noStep: Rules.SpeedRule = { Base = 9, HitsPerStep = 4, Step = 0, Max = 13 }
		Test.ExpectEqual(Rules.BallSpeed(noStep, 40), 9, "a zero step keeps the speed constant")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The rules of Breakout played in the Main scene: serving, launching, the
-- paddle, scoring, losing lives, game over, winning, restarting and the
-- ball's speed-up.
local GameScript = require("../Scripts/Game")
local BrickScript = require("../Scripts/Brick")

-- Where the paddle keeps its centre relative to the ball while returning it,
-- so the bounces leave at an angle.
local AimOffset = 0.4

local function getGame(): GameScript.Game
	local entity = Scene.FindByName("Game")
	if entity == nil then
		Test.Fail("the scene has no Game entity")
	end
	return (entity :: Entity):GetScript() :: GameScript.Game
end

local function textOf(entity: Entity?): string
	if entity then
		local text = entity.Text
		if text then
			return text.Text
		end
	end
	return ""
end

local function launch(game: GameScript.Game)
	Test.InjectAction("Launch", "Tap")
	Test.WaitUntil(function(): boolean
		return game.State.Phase == "Playing"
	end, 10)
end

-- Test setup: puts the ball below the paddle and waits until the game has
-- noticed that it fell out.
local function dropBall(game: GameScript.Game)
	local ball = game.Ball :: Entity
	local body = ball.RigidBody :: RigidBody
	body:Teleport(vector.create(0, game.DeathY - 1, 0))
	Test.WaitUntil(function(): boolean
		return game.State.Phase ~= "Playing"
	end, 10)
end

local function activeBricks(game: GameScript.Game): number
	local count = 0
	for _, brick in ipairs(game.Bricks) do
		if brick:IsActive() then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

local function ballSpeed(game: GameScript.Game): number
	local ball = game.Ball :: Entity
	local body = ball.RigidBody :: RigidBody
	return vector.magnitude(body:GetLinearVelocity())
end

-- Returns the ball with the paddle, like a player pressing MoveX, until the
-- rally has the given number of paddle hits; fails if the ball is lost.
-- Calls check(game) every tick.
local function returnBall(game: GameScript.Game, hits: number, check: (GameScript.Game) -> ())
	local paddle = game.Paddle :: Entity
	local ball = game.Ball :: Entity
	while game.State.RallyHits < hits do
		if game.State.Phase ~= "Playing" then
			Test.Fail("the ball was lost before the rally reached " .. tostring(hits) .. " paddle hits")
		end
		local dx = ball.Transform.WorldPosition.x - AimOffset - paddle.Transform.WorldPosition.x
		Test.InjectAction("MoveX", nil, math.clamp(dx * 1.5, -1, 1))
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		check(game)
	end
	Test.InjectAction("MoveX", nil, 0)
end

return Test.Suite("Breakout", function()
	Test.Case("starts serving with full lives and every brick", function()
		local game = getGame()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Phase, "Serve")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Lives, 3)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Score, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(#game.Bricks, 50, "the grid has 5 rows of 10 bricks")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.BricksLeft, 50)
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.ScoreText), "SCORE 0")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.LivesText), "LIVES 3")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.MessageText), "PRESS SPACE TO LAUNCH")
	end)

	Test.Case("launch sends the ball up at a constant speed", function()
		local game = getGame()
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectNear(ballSpeed(game), 0, 1e-4, "the served ball rests on the paddle")
		launch(game)
		Test.WaitTicks(20)
		local ball = game.Ball :: Entity
		local body = ball.RigidBody :: RigidBody
		Test.Expect(body:GetLinearVelocity().y > 0, "the ball flies up")
		Test.ExpectNear(ballSpeed(game), game.BallSpeed, 1e-3, "the ball leaves at the serve speed")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.MessageText), "")
		-- Sample the speed every 10 ticks while the ball is in play: it bounces
		-- off bricks and walls in that time and keeps its speed, which changes
		-- only with the rally's paddle hits.
		local samples = 0
		while game.State.Phase == "Playing" and samples < 30 do
			Test.ExpectNear(ballSpeed(game), game:CurrentSpeed(), 1e-3, "the ball keeps its speed")
			Test.ExpectNear(ball.Transform.WorldPosition.z, 0, 1e-4, "the ball stays in the play plane")
			samples += 1
			Test.WaitTicks(10)
		end
		Test.Expect(samples >= 10, "the ball stays in play long enough to sample its speed")
		Test.Expect(game.BricksBroken > 0, "the sampled flight includes a brick hit")
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 900 })

	Test.Case("the paddle follows MoveX and stops at the walls", function()
		local game = getGame()
		local paddle = game.Paddle :: Entity
		Test.InjectAction("MoveX", nil, 1)
		Test.WaitTicks(90)
		Test.ExpectNear(game.PaddleX, game.PaddleLimit, 1e-4, "the paddle stops at the right wall")
		Test.ExpectNear(paddle.Transform.WorldPosition.x, game.PaddleLimit, 1e-3)
		Test.InjectAction("MoveX", nil, -1)
		Test.WaitTicks(150)
		Test.ExpectNear(game.PaddleX, -game.PaddleLimit, 1e-4, "the paddle stops at the left wall")
		Test.InjectAction("MoveX", nil, 0)
		Test.WaitTicks(5)
		local ball = game.Ball :: Entity
		Test.ExpectNear(ball.Transform.WorldPosition.x, -game.PaddleLimit, 1e-3, "the served ball follows the paddle")
	end)

	Test.Case("the ball breaks the brick it hits and scores", function()
		local game = getGame()

-- whenever a ball is lost.

--!strict
-- Test-only autopilot that plays Breakout like a player, for recording the
-- Opening replay: it only reads the scene and injects the MoveX and Launch
-- actions. It keeps the ball in play off the paddle until the rally has sped
-- the ball up and bricks have broken, then lets the ball fall to lose a life,
-- serves again and returns the ball once more. It ends with the ball in play
-- and the played state still in the scene (broken bricks, the score and the
-- lost life on the HUD), so the recording depends on its input; restarts are
-- covered by the Breakout suite.
local GameScript = require("../../Scripts/Game")

-- Proportional steering gain of the paddle and where the paddle aims under
-- the ball, so the bounces leave at an angle.
local Gain = 1.5
local AimOffset = 0.4

local function getGame(): GameScript.Game
	local entity = Scene.FindByName("Game")
	if entity == nil then
		Test.Fail("the scene has no Game entity")
	end
	return (entity :: Entity):GetScript() :: GameScript.Game
end

local function ballX(game: GameScript.Game): number
	return (game.Ball :: Entity).Transform.WorldPosition.x
end

local function ballSpeed(game: GameScript.Game): number
	local body = (game.Ball :: Entity).RigidBody :: RigidBody
	return vector.magnitude(body:GetLinearVelocity())
end

local function textOf(entity: Entity?): string
	if entity then
		local text = entity.Text
		if text then
			return text.Text
		end
	end
	return ""
end

local function activeBricks(game: GameScript.Game): number
	local count = 0
	for _, brick in ipairs(game.Bricks) do
		if brick:IsActive() then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

-- Pushes MoveX towards the paddle position x for one tick.
local function steer(game: GameScript.Game, x: number)
	local paddle = game.Paddle :: Entity
	local dx = x - paddle.Transform.WorldPosition.x
	Test.InjectAction("MoveX", nil, math.clamp(dx * Gain, -1, 1))
	Test.WaitTicks(1)
end

local function serve()
	Test.InjectAction("Launch", "Tap")
	Test.WaitTicks(2)
end

-- Follows the ball with the paddle until done() holds, serving again
-- whenever a ball is lost.
local function rally(game: GameScript.Game, done: () -> boolean)
	while not done() do
		if game.State.Phase == "Serve" then
			serve()
		else
			steer(game, ballX(game) - AimOffset)
		end
	end
end

return Test.Suite("Autopilot.Breakout", function()
	Test.Case("hits, speeds up, breaks bricks and loses a life", function()
		local game = getGame()
		Test.WaitTicks(30)
		serve()
		rally(game, function(): boolean
			return game.State.RallyHits >= game.SpeedUpHits and game.BricksBroken >= 3
		end)
		Test.WaitTicks(2)
		Test.Expect(ballSpeed(game) > game.BallSpeed + 0.5 * game.SpeedStep, "the rally sped the ball up")

		-- Let the ball go: keep the paddle far from it until a life is lost.
		local lost = game.LivesLost
		while game.LivesLost == lost do
			local x = ballX(game)
			local paddleX = (game.Paddle :: Entity).Transform.WorldPosition.x
			steer(game, if x > paddleX then x - 6 else x + 6)
		end
		Test.InjectAction("MoveX", nil, 0)
		Test.WaitTicks(30)
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.RallyHits, 0, "the lost ball ended the rally")

		-- Serve again and return the ball once more, then end with the ball in play.
		local hits = game.PaddleHits
		rally(game, function(): boolean
			return game.PaddleHits > hits
		end)
		Test.InjectAction("MoveX", nil, 0)
		Test.WaitTicks(20)

		Test.Expect(game.PaddleHits > game.SpeedUpHits, "the ball came off the paddle")
		Test.Expect(game.BricksBroken >= 3, "bricks broke")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.LivesLost, 1, "one life was lost")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Phase, "Playing", "the recording ends with the ball in play")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.Lives, game.StartLives - 1)
		Test.Expect(game.State.Score > 0, "the broken bricks scored")
		Test.ExpectEqual(game.State.BricksLeft, #game.Bricks - game.BricksBroken)
		Test.ExpectEqual(activeBricks(game), game.State.BricksLeft, "the broken bricks are gone from the scene")
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.ScoreText), "SCORE " .. tostring(game.State.Score))
		Test.ExpectEqual(textOf(game.LivesText), "LIVES " .. tostring(game.State.Lives))
		Test.InjectAction("Restart", "Tap")
		Test.WaitTicks(30)
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 7200 })
end)
